title: Right to Free, Universal, Scientific and Research-Oriented Education Institutional Power Map

nodes.name: National Scientific Research Foundation (NSRF)
nodes.appointment_chain: President of India on recommendation of Prime Minister and Chief Scientific Adviser

nodes.name: State Education Fee Regulation Commissions
nodes.appointment_chain: State Government in consultation with Chief Justice of High Court
powers: Fee caps on private educational institutions

nodes.name: National Education Quality and Integrity Inspectorate

power_chains.description: Statutory universal free education entitlement -> State public infrastructure expansion -> Zero fee enrollment (Age 3-22)
power_chains.vulnerability: Risk of private school fee gouging or commercial capitation fees
power_chains.mitigation: State Fee Regulation Commissions + 3 to 10 years imprisonment for capitation fees (Clause 18)

power_chains.description: 3% GDP R&D budget allocation -> NSRF competitive grants -> 500,000 Undergraduate Fellowships
power_chains.vulnerability: Risk of political bias or unscientific grant allocation
power_chains.mitigation: Independent peer-review scientific merit requirement + open digital grant tracking
